intent: A minimal SHTTPSManager subclass used by tests to make outbound HTTPS requests and read back their status code, with no product-specific response handling.

objects.name: TestHTTPS
objects.role: trivial SHTTPSManager subclass; exposes sendRequest publicly and parses the response status code out of the raw HTTP method line in _onRecv

location_fit.note: Fits; test-only HTTPS helper alongside the rest of test/lib.
